notes.title: Fallen Knight Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone is staying healthy and well! After speaking with the community and receiving feedback we have made some adjustments to Lancelot's heal! For more details do read below.

[h2]Fallen Knight Patch 1.05 Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lancelot is now allowed to heal himself whilst moving and holding the heal button (applies after ≈2.5 secs). This applies to all movement; running, dashing, jumping, wall running, etc. 
[*] Idle/sitting healing speed has been reduced from 2 secs to 1.5 secs (Focus Heal has been adjusted as well).
[*] Reduced "Double Heal" unlock criteria from 500HP to 50HP.
[*] Fixed and improved Japanese localization.
[*] Fixed bug where previously players are unable to press any button at the "Results" screen after defeating Lucifer.
[/list]

[h2]Still finding bugs? Help report them ♥[/h2]

notes.title: Q.O.L Improvements Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone has had a wonderful week and has enjoyed the update from Patch 1.0.1. We appreciate the constant feedback and the support as always. Please find the updates that have already been released with our hotfix patches throughout the previous week and also find what we are currently working on below ♥

[h2]Hotfixes Released Last Week[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improve character controls and controller input
[*] Fix "Retry" issue (where some parts of the game, when selecting "Retry" it bugs out
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Q.O.L Improvement Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Camera adjustment (where sometimes when Lancelot moves too fast the camera doesn't catch up)
[*] Add PC resolution setting and Windowed Mode
[*] Adjust consistency for "Parry & Disarm" for each enemy type and boss
[*] Possible addition to add Honor Points when killing enemies
[*] Fix missing UI for tutorial when obtaining new abilities
[*] Wall hang input may be adjusted to allow players better control on when they want to climb walls
[*] Investigating issues with some players not receiving achievements after meeting all conditions.
[*] Working on solution for controller UI input for the Tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Futuristic Side-Scroller Fallen Knight Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png[/img]

In this fast-paced futuristic[i] knights tale[/i], play as the descendant of the fabled Sir Lancelot in an armoured throw-down of the ages to [b]shield your city from The Purge.[/b]

[b]Lancelot the 50th[/b] has sworn an oath to protect the 'truth' from an evil organisation and must face off against [i]six[/i] unique enemy heroes with a [b]dark past[/b] of their own.

[h2]Introducing 'The Juggernaught' - The Lord Of Blast[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d254d2b76d98e336f022fba9318adcca55550747.gif[/img]

A tough opponent - you must use everything you've learned to [b]conquer this enemy.[/b] 
[b]Dash, jump & slash[/b] your way to success with lightening-fast reflexes. Landing a well timed dodge is key to defeating this challenger, use your agility to contrast his [b]brute strength.[/b]

Earn honour points to [b]upgrade your abilities, health and attacks[/b]. This can be a crucial tactic to obtain your success [b]and become unstoppable![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/a6e500e0edfb4549772a92904f1d27a49a65880a.gif[/img]

All is not what it seems with your opponents, learn about their past and motives as you cut your way through your quest and [b]uncover the reality of The Purge.[/b]

Each boss is a [b]unique battle[/b], master your techniques and achieve the honour & glory worthy of a knight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/45897cdb73ae16411d42bf8653529fb6ede15c1c.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

Make sure to keep up to date with Fallen Knight by adding to your wishlist on steam, or by  visiting our [url=https://pqube.co.uk/fallen-knight/?utm_source=sendinblue&utm_campaign=Fallen_Knight_Gameplay_Feature&utm_medium=email]website.[/url]

[b][h3][b]Fallen Knight will be coming to PC on 23rd June, 2021.[/b][/h3][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378370/Fallen_Knight/
